steps.note: Start a new RFX project on the multi-stage creation flow.
Disable technical-stage template editing during creation as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory project title for the create flow.
Configure the project with a Technical Stage.
Open the Technical Stage creation screen where the questionnaire template fields are configured.
Apply the pre-loaded technical questionnaire template so its fields are available for inspection.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage creation screen, attempt to modify the pre-loaded questionnaire template fields and verify that the template editing controls are visibly disabled or locked because is_rfp_template_edit_allowed_during_creation is Off; stop with the locked controls shown

steps.note: Inspect and exercise the specific template editing controls that have no dedicated catalog assertion.
Confirm the technical creation screen remains rendered without an error or crash after the locked-edit inspection.
